260:t_005:8.en:
$$勝平$$
「That's right! You want us to turn our backs on the enemy!?」

260:t_005:11.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「We're not in a position to fight to our limits, then return to base for repairs.」

260:t_005:12.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Even if we win here, taking damage will only mean our end in the next battle.」

260:t_005:17.en:
$$甲児$$
「That's not what I mean...! If we turn our backs, they'll jump at the chance to attack us...!」

260:t_005:19.en:
$$甲児$$
「It's obvious! We charge forward with all we've got!」

260:t_005:20.en:
$$甲児$$
「Then we crush them so thoroughly they'll never even think of attacking us again!!」

260:t_006:0.en:
$$シモン$$
「$$マジンガー$$ is burning!」

260:t_006:1.en:
$$隼人$$
「Is Photon Power reacting to $$甲児$$'s fighting spirit!?」

260:t_007:0.en:
$$さやか$$
「That light...! Is it Photon Power energy!?」

260:t_008:0.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「Did you call me, warriors of steel!?」

260:t_008:2.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「Your courage, your fighting spirit... and your hope have called me once more!」

260:t_008:4.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「You! You should have exhausted your power and fallen into eternal sleep between dimensions...!」

260:t_008:5.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「As long as there is hope in the world, light will return! And $$ゼウス$$, god of that light, is eternal!」

260:t_008:6.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「Now, my brothers and sisters of light! Let us fight these fiends together!!」

260:t_009:1.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Power is filling my heart and body!!」

260:t_009:2.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「That is the power of hope! It is a signpost to the future, borne by those who possess the power of life!」

260:t_009:4.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Curse you, $$ゼウス$$!! You turn your sword on us again!?」

260:t_009:5.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「You are not my only foes! I fight all the darkness in this world!」

260:t_009:7.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「Let us fight together, warriors of steel!」

260:t_009:9.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「...We no longer need the retreat simulation.」

260:t_009:10.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「We advance with all our strength! Hope will guide our way!」

260:t_009:12.en:
$n
「Hope will guide our way... I like that!」

260:t_009:13.en:
$$甲児$$
「Let's go! We'll smash everything in our way and push on!!」

260:t_010:1.en:
$$田中司令$$
「For a moment, I feared for us, but we pulled through.」

260:t_010:2.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「We have the god $$ゼウス$$'s power to thank for that.」

260:t_010:3.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「No. It was because the light of hope burned in your hearts.」

260:t_010:5.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「$$兜甲児$$... and $$マジンガーＺ$$. I was glad to see you again.」

260:t_010:6.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Ah! Wait, $$ゼウス$$! We've got a favor to ask!」

260:t_010:7.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「Humanity must forge its own path. As your brother, I merely watch over you.」

260:t_010:8.en:
$$勝平$$
「You're stingy! Haven't you heard of praying to the gods when you're in trouble!?」

260:t_010:10.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I-I'm sorry! I'll have a word with these children later!」

260:t_010:11.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「No, it's quite all right! To be honest, I don't mind being relied upon!」

260:t_010:14.en:
$$青山$$
(Come to think of it, he came to help without being asked in both the $$時獄戦役$$ and today's battle.)

260:t_010:15.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Oh, then! $$ノノ$$ wants her own $$バスターマシン$$ to...」

260:t_010:17.en:
$$甲児$$
「$$ゼウス$$... An accident sent us out here to the galactic center.」

260:t_010:18.en:
$$甲児$$
「But we have things we must do on Earth.」

260:t_010:19.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「Say no more, $$兜甲児$$. ...You must fight them.」

260:t_010:20.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「Then I, $$ゼウス$$, shall use the power I have now to deliver you to Earth!」

260:t_011:1.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「You need not thank me, brother. We are comrades who face the crisis threatening the universe together.」

260:t_011:3.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「You will learn of it in time. When that time comes, I...」

260:t_013:1.en:
$$スズネ$$
「This clearly... isn't anywhere near Earth.」

260:t_013:2.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「What the heck! Did $$ゼウス$$ mess up!?」

260:t_013:6.en:
$$甲児$$
「It looked like something happened to $$ゼウス$$ back then...」
